usedFor: Acadle holds your learners, and HubSpot keeps their contact records current when “New User” runs “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “User Activated” in Acadle, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Activation changes a learner's status, and the action updates the matching contact by its email.

watchOut: Acadle triggers like “User Deactivated” are polling, and “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so match emails.
